changelog.summary: Adds a checkout-level recovery proposal with current-order, consent, suppression, duplicate-send, and provider-evidence gates.

title: Checkout Signal to Reviewed Recovery
description: Turn a Shopify abandoned checkout signal into a contact-policy review and an unsent recovery draft, with separate proof for any later send or order.
setup_prompt: Use Checkout Signal to Reviewed Recovery as a chat-led proposal for one authorized Shopify abandoned checkout and one channel. Discover an existing Shopify Growth Analyst and Checkout Recovery Coordinator, then propose reuse or reviewed creation. Check current checkout completion, linked later order, merchant contact policy, channel consent, opt-out, existing Shopify or provider automation, prior sends, and owner. Show a validated signal-to-review handoff, a suppressed or unknown test case, an unsent draft when eligible, a manual first run, and separate proof for any later approved message or order. Selection alone does not connect customer data, enable automation, send, discount, or claim recovered revenue.

setup_inputs.label: Authorized store, market, exact checkout ID, campaign ID and channel
Current merchant contact, consent, frequency, and suppression policy with owner
Checkout/order, consent, and prior-message records or scoped exports
Definition of provider send and verified linked-order outcome
Manual-only or reviewed authenticated event and notification route

recommended_tools.purpose: Re-read exact checkout and completion state

recommended_tools.purpose: Verify current channel permission, opt-out and exclusions

pulse_focus.label: Checkout recovery review
focus_areas: Eligible checkouts with owner-reviewed next action
Duplicate contacts, suppressed checkouts, and provider-confirmed outcomes
review_when: Checkout or consent state changes, an existing automation schedules a send, or an approved message lacks a provider receipt

outputs: Reviewed Crew roster, source and contact-policy map
Suppressed, unknown, or owner-reviewed unsent draft
Separate provider send and linked-order evidence if later executed
